route: /style-board/ (the style board: module cta:image-band, longest and shortest copy, photos as grey frames)

findings.issue: Flagged in the last review and still not fixed: in both samples the photo band stops about 20 px short of the screen edge on each side, so it looks like a boxed panel inside the content gutter rather than a closing band across the full width.
findings.reference: On home 17 the competitor's closing image band runs edge to edge across the 1440 px viewport with no side margin, and its copy keeps to the content's left edge.
findings.fix: In reference.css, make `.block--cta[data-variant="image-band"] .cta` full-bleed: `margin-inline: calc(50% - 50vw); width: 100vw; border-radius: 0`. Keep the container gutter as the inline padding of `.cta__content` so the heading still starts on the content's left edge. The 1024px+ `--cta-copy-end` gradient then needs the same `max(0px, (100% - var(--container-max) - 2 * var(--gutter)) / 2) + var(--gutter)` offset that `.block--band` already uses.

findings.issue: Flagged in the last review and still not fixed: at 390 px the band is inset by the gutter on both sides and lines up with the FAQ list above it, so it reads as a dark card rather than a full-width photo band.
findings.reference: At 390 px the competitor's closing band fills the screen edge to edge.
findings.fix: Apply the same full-bleed rule to `.block--cta[data-variant="image-band"] .cta` at every width (`margin-inline: calc(50% - 50vw); width: 100vw`) and keep the 1.25rem inset as the padding of `.cta__content`.

findings.issue: Flagged in the last review and still not fixed: in both samples the copy block is centred vertically in the band (longest: heading to button runs from about 29% to 70% of the band's height; shortest: about 30% to 72%), while the competitor's copy sits low in the band.
findings.reference: On home 17 the competitor's eyebrow, h2, paragraph and buttons run from about 43% to 83% of the band's height, leaving the upper part of the photo clear with the copy resting above the lower edge.
findings.fix: In reference.css at min-width 1024px, set `[data-variant="image-band"] .cta` to `align-items: flex-end` (or `align-self: end` on `.cta__content`) with `padding-block-end: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 6rem)`. Leave the min-height as it is.

findings.issue: Still the case, though better than before: in the longest sample the button label 'TALK TO US ABOUT SWIMWEAR PACKAGING & CUSTOM BRAND LABELS' still wraps to two centred lines even at the reduced 0.8125rem size. That turns the full-width pill into a tall slab, against reference.css's own aim of keeping the label on one line.
findings.reference: The competitor's band buttons carry one to three words each (BOOK A CALL-BACK, WHATSAPP, VISIT US, EMAIL US), so each stays a single-line pill on phones.
findings.fix: In Site Factory, shorten this CTA's button label to a few words (for example 'Request a label quote') and leave the topic to the heading.
